name: Growth and ROIC peers
mechanism: Within an industry, firms with similar growth and returns on capital share the discount rate and growth expectations that set EV/EBITDA.

name: Size and margin peers
mechanism: Practitioner default: pick sector peers of similar scale and profitability.

name: Margin-matched sales peers
mechanism: EV/Sales mostly prices future margins, so peers should match on margin first and growth second.
